_comment: Image-mode (non-logo) prompt templates for the Logo Generator's 'Image' mode. Edit strings here; variable substitution happens at runtime. Variables: {style_direction} (art-direction phrase for the selected style), {subject} (user description), {size} (composition/aspect phrase), {detail} (detail-level direction), {colors} (color instruction or empty), {bg} (background phrase or empty), {shape} (shape container instruction or empty).
template: A high-quality {style_direction} image of {subject}. {size}. {detail}{colors}{bg}{shape}Professional composition, clear focal point, clean anatomy and readable silhouettes. Do not include logos, watermarks, captions, or text unless text is explicitly requested.

style_direction.retro: vintage retro, nostalgic color grading, classic
style_direction.minimalist: minimalist, lots of negative space, simple and clean
style_direction.greetingcard: hand-painted watercolor illustration, soft washes and paper texture
style_direction.photorealistic: photorealistic, professional photography, sharp focus and natural lighting
style_direction.chrome: glossy 3D chrome render, reflective metallic surfaces, studio-lit

size_direction.16:9: Wide 16:9 aspect ratio with horizontal framing
size_direction.9:16: Tall 9:16 aspect ratio with vertical framing

default.min: Flat graphic image with simple shapes, clean solid fills, minimal texture, minimal shadows, and little to no background detail.
default.medium: Moderately detailed rendering with controlled lighting, clear subject separation, simplified background detail, and restrained texture.
default.max: Highly detailed rendering with layered depth, dramatic lighting, texture, atmosphere, and polished finish.

fantasy.min: Flat fantasy image/logo style with simplified characters and creature shapes, clean solid color areas, bold silhouettes, minimal internal detail, no painterly texture, no cinematic lighting, and little to no background detail.
fantasy.medium: Moderately detailed fantasy illustration with readable characters and action, simplified environment, restrained magic effects, controlled lighting, limited texture, and less atmospheric depth than a cinematic scene.
fantasy.max: Epic fantasy battle scene with cinematic scale, wide establishing composition, dramatic sky, distant environment, foreground/midground/background depth, painterly brushwork, glowing magic or fire effects, atmospheric haze, and richly detailed armor, creature anatomy, terrain, and architecture when relevant.

default.min: Flat isolated subject cutout with clean solid shapes, simple color fills, minimal texture, and crisp edges.
default.medium: Moderately detailed isolated subject cutout with clean edges, readable silhouette, simplified texture, and no background elements.
default.max: Highly detailed isolated subject cutout with clean edges, layered internal detail, dramatic lighting on the subject, texture, and polished finish, with no background elements.

fantasy.min: Flat isolated fantasy image/logo cutout with simplified character and creature shapes, bold silhouettes, solid fills, minimal internal detail, crisp edges, and no background elements.
fantasy.medium: Moderately detailed isolated fantasy action cutout with clear character and creature silhouettes, restrained magic effects, simplified texture, clean edges, and no background elements.
fantasy.max: Highly detailed isolated fantasy action cutout with the requested characters, creature anatomy, armor, weapons, fire or magic effects, painterly texture, clean transparent edges, readable silhouettes, and no sky, terrain, architecture, horizon, ground plane, or scenery.
